d:
What better way to experience Goa’s new Porvorim Elevated Corridor than with a stunning lineup of supercars? Prior to its public inauguration, we brought together an incredible collection of machines, from Ferraris and McLarens to a Porsche 911 Turbo S, Lamborghini Huracan Spyder and Bentley Continental GT Speed, for a special drive along this newly opened stretch of road.
Cameraperson: Sharad Vegada, Harshad Panchal
Editor: Siddhesh Bhogale
